title: Spread out: thin own crowds
question: Do armies jam less when a move is rewarded for leaving a crowd of own units?
change: A move gets +spread per own unit fewer next to the target tile than next to the unit's current tile; like movement noise, it also allows a sideways step when that makes the score positive.
method: Strength sweeps (200 games per point, final test 400): on the champion, and on the champion plus movement noise
